Name: ASSET_MODEL_SFX_PARAM_ST
Description: Particle effects attached to a placed asset's model. Up to 8 effects per row, each spawned at every dummy poly with the matching dummy poly ID. The row ID likely follows the Elden Ring scheme (asset model number x 1000 + state x 100 + relative ID).

Fields.Name: Particle: ID [0]
Fields.Description: Effect 0. Spawned at every dummy poly with Dummy Polygon ID [0]. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Particle: Dummy Polygon ID [0]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly that effect 0 attaches to; one effect per matching dummy poly. 0 or below: effect 0 is not spawned.
